keywords_en: criminal; embezzlement; first instance; intermediate people's court; Anhui Province; natural person; criminal law; determination of embezzlement amount; determination of voluntary surrender; application of mitigated punishment; support for plaintiff; false invoice reimbursement; misappropriation of public funds; voluntary surrender; acceptance of bribes
full_text_en:
Liu Yushan — corruption case

Defendant: Liu Yushan, male, 61 years old, former deputy director of the Machinery Industry Department of the People's Government of Anhui Province. Arrested on October 8, 1989.

The case of Liu Yushan's corruption was prosecuted by the Hefei City People's Procuratorate of Anhui Province to the Hefei Intermediate People's Court. The court formed a collegial panel according to law and, after public trial, found the following facts:

During his tenure as deputy director of the Machinery Industry Department of the People's Government of Anhui Province, from March 1988 to August 1989, the defendant Liu Yushan took advantage of his position, under the pretext of making plans and initiating projects for subordinate enterprises and giving gifts to relevant personnel, misappropriated blank sales invoices from the sales department of Beijing Friendship Hotel and Hefei Shuerman Department Store, filled in the names and amounts himself, fabricated purchases of She inkstones, Xuan paper, brushes and ink, iron paintings, Nescafe coffee, expensive cigarettes and alcohol, and other goods, then reimbursed these fake invoices in 57 enterprises subordinate to the Machinery Industry Department across 12 prefectures and cities in the province, thereby embezzling public funds and property worth a total of RMB 75,413.90, and unlawfully took possession of them.

After the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate issued the "Notice on the Requirement for Criminals of Embezzlement, Bribery, Speculation and Profiteering to Surrender and Confess within a Time Limit" (hereinafter referred to as the "Notice"), on August 25, 1989, the defendant Liu Yushan, carrying 8 deposit slips totaling RMB 47,600, voluntarily surrendered to the Anhui Provincial Supervisory Department and proactively confessed to some of his criminal facts. After being subjected to compulsory measures, Liu Yushan additionally confessed to some other criminal facts. After the case was uncovered, the illicit money that Liu Yushan had returned and the items purchased with the illicit money, including one camera and one zoom lens, were recovered.

The above facts are confirmed by witness testimony, documentary evidence such as the reimbursed fake invoices, and the recovered illicit money. The defendant Liu Yushan also confessed to them without denial.

The Hefei Intermediate People's Court, upon trial, held that: The defendant Liu Yushan, as a state functionary, took advantage of his position, under the pretext of entertaining superior leaders and giving gifts, fabricated purchases and reimbursed self-filled invoices in subordinate enterprises to embezzle public property, and his conduct constituted the crime of corruption as provided in Article 155 of the Criminal Law of the PRC. The amount of Liu Yushan's corruption was huge, and the circumstances were serious, warranting severe punishment. Pursuant to the decision in Article 2 of the "Notice" of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, which states: "... Whoever voluntarily surrenders and confesses, actively returns illicit gains, or has meritorious reporting or performance, shall be dealt with leniency in accordance with Articles 63 and 59 of the Criminal Law. Among them, ... if the crime is serious and a heavy punishment should be imposed according to law, a lighter or mitigated punishment may be imposed, or the punishment may be remitted." In view of the fact that Liu Yushan voluntarily surrendered within the specified time limit carrying part of the illicit money, confessed to his crimes, and after being subjected to compulsory measures additionally confessed to part of the criminal facts and actively returned illicit gains, etc., he should be given a mitigated punishment as deemed appropriate. The illicit money and property from Liu Yushan's corruption shall be recovered pursuant to Article 60 of the Criminal Law. Pursuant to Article 2(1) of the Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Punishment of Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery, part of Liu Yushan's personal property shall also be confiscated.

Accordingly, the Hefei Intermediate People's Court on October 27, 1989, adjudged as follows:

1. The defendant Liu Yushan is found guilty of corruption and sentenced to four years' imprisonment;
2. The illicit money obtained by the defendant Liu Yushan from the crime, totaling RMB 61,035.85 and, exchanged with the illicit RMB, USD 2,815 and HKD 450, as well as the illicit items including one camera and one zoom lens, shall be recovered;
3. The defendant Liu Yushan's personal property, one air conditioner and one refrigerator, shall be confiscated.

After the first instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant Liu Yushan did not appeal.
